package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "fmt"
    "maps"
    "os"
    "slices"
    "strings"
    "sync/atomic"
    "example.invalid/textiterator/dispatch"
)

func semantics() {
    equal := func(got, want []string) {
        if !slices.Equal(got, want) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("iterator mismatch: %q != %q", got, want)) }
    }
    equal(slices.Collect(strings.Lines("a\nb\nc")), []string{"a\n", "b\n", "c"})
    equal(slices.Collect(strings.SplitSeq("a::b::", "::")), []string{"a", "b", ""})
    equal(slices.Collect(strings.SplitAfterSeq("a::b", "::")), []string{"a::", "b"})
    equal(slices.Collect(strings.FieldsSeq(" a\u2003b  c ")), []string{"a", "b", "c"})
    equal(slices.Collect(strings.FieldsFuncSeq("a,b;c", func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ';' })),
        []string{"a", "b", "c"})
    if len(slices.Collect(strings.Lines(""))) != 0 { panic("empty lines") }
    count := 0
    for range strings.SplitSeq("one,two,three", ",") { count++; break }
    if count != 1 { panic("string early stop") }

    lines := slices.Collect(bytes.Lines([]byte("a\nb\nc")))
    if len(lines) != 3 || !bytes.Equal(lines[0], []byte("a\n")) || !bytes.Equal(lines[2], []byte("c")) {
        panic("byte lines")
    }
    for _, line := range lines { if cap(line) != len(line) { panic("byte capacity widened") } }
    fields := slices.Collect(bytes.FieldsSeq([]byte(" a\u2003b  c ")))
    if len(fields) != 3 || string(fields[0]) != "a" || string(fields[1]) != "b" || string(fields[2]) != "c" {
        panic("byte fields")
    }
    split := slices.Collect(bytes.SplitSeq([]byte("a::b::"), []byte("::")))
    if len(split) != 3 || string(split[0]) != "a" || string(split[1]) != "b" || len(split[2]) != 0 {
        panic("byte split")
    }
    count = 0
    for range bytes.SplitAfterSeq([]byte("a,b,c"), []byte(",")) { count++; break }
    if count != 1 { panic("byte early stop") }
    if !maps.Equal(maps.Collect(maps.All(map[int]int{1: 2})), map[int]int{1: 2}) {
        panic("map iterator changed")
    }
    fmt.Println("semantics=ok")
}

func main() {
    if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "semantics" { dispatch.Enable(); semantics(); return }
    kind := os.Args[1]
    input := strings.Repeat("a", 2_000_000)
    data := []byte(input)
    var ran atomic.Bool
    if len(os.Args) > 2 && os.Args[2] == "alone" {
        dispatch.Enable()
    } else {
        start, ready := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
        go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
        <-ready
        dispatch.Enable()
        close(start)
    }
    before := dispatch.Count()
    count := 0
    if kind == "strings" {
        for range strings.FieldsSeq(input) { count++ }
    } else if kind == "bytes" {
        for range bytes.FieldsSeq(data) { count++ }
    } else { panic("unknown kind") }
    sibling, yields := ran.Load(), dispatch.Count()-before
    if count != 1 { panic("iterator result") }
    fmt.Printf("kind=%s sibling=%t count=%d yields=%d\n", kind, sibling, count, yields)
}
